name: QG-I1621: Percentage fees above 100% are refused by the calculator and the API
description:
Objective: QG-I1621: Percentage fees above 100% are refused by the calculator and the API.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions calculator with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Bug regressions calculator.
2. QG-I1621: Percentage fees above 100% are refused by the calculator and the API.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The behavior named in the scenario is observed and its assertions pass.
descriptionHtml:
Objective: QG-I1621: Percentage fees above 100% are refused by the calculator and the API.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions calculator with the configured test data.
Steps:

  1. Open Bug regressions calculator.

statusMessage:
AssertionError: Percentage fees above 100% are not refused:
  - PUT /offer/{id}/fees saved a percentage above 100% (HTTP 200): [('PAD Fee', 100, 100), ('UW Fee', 150, 30000)].
  - PUT /offer/{id}/fees saved a percentage above 100% (HTTP 200): [('PAD Fee', 100, 100), ('UW Fee', 1, 200), ('Other Fee', 150, 30000)].
assert not ["PUT /offer/{id}/fees saved a percentage above 100% (HTTP 200): [('PAD Fee', 100, 100), ('UW Fee', 150, 30000)].", "P...ees saved a percentage above 100% (HTTP 200): [('PAD Fee', 100, 100), ('UW Fee', 1, 200), ('Other Fee', 150, 30000)]."]
statusTrace:
tests/e2e/calculator/test_bug_regressions_calculator.py:1052: in test_percentage_fees_above_100_percent_are_refused
    assert not problems, "Percentage fees above 100% are not refused:\n- " + "\n- ".join(problems)
